metadata.notes: Baseline for sift-email (issue #111), evals 1-21, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail, Claude Docs, and Contacts stubs, on SKILL.md as committed with this baseline. The skill now sets disable-model-invocation, so every eval prompt starts with /sift-email; every trial ran the skill through that slash command. Run 1 started on 2026-10-11 and both runs crossed midnight in the fixtures' rubric timezone, so trials read 2026-10-11 or 2026-10-12 from the clock (fixtures anchored to 2026-10-10, not shifted). Graders held "the run date" to the date the clock gave in the rubric's timezone. Failures, all run 2 and all the same bug: a changelog entry dated with the machine's local date instead of the rubric timezone's date (evals 5, 15, and 20); eval 5 also never read the clock and wrote an invented log time. Not graded, seen in a few trials: an About me note dated with the machine's local date beside a log heading in the rubric's date, About me notes added when the lookups found nothing or given the wrong source, log entries missing per-thread lines or count lines, user labels searched by name instead of id, Step 2 checks skipped, and replies opening with process narration. No trial wrote first person for the user in doc text.
